root_cause: The redesigned checkpoint buttons inherited the legacy circular-hero classes stage-button and stage-N. Those legacy selectors applied absolute positioning, a white active background, and translate(-50%, -50%), clipping the first checkpoint and expanding the selected checkpoint into a white column.
